title: A Unified Vision-Language Model for PSMA PET/CT Report Generation, Visual Question Answering, and Lesion Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2609.15603v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate PSMA PET/CT interpretation is central to prostate cancer management, yet existing PET/CT AI models typically address isolated tasks. We propose a unified PSMA PET/CT vision-language model for report generation, visual question answering, and lesion segmentation. The framework adopts an LLaVA-style architecture, comprising a PET/CT vision encoder, an MLP-Mixer projection module, a LoRA-tuned large language model, and a 3D segmentation branch. Training followed a four-stage strategy: vision encoder pretraining, projection-layer alignment, VLM fine-tuning, and final multitask tuning. Language tasks used 5,747 PSMA PET/CT datasets with paired reports, while segmentation used the PSMA subset of AutoPET. The model outperformed PET2REP and a CT-based baseline across standard report-generation metrics, improved performance across VQA question types, and achieved higher Dice and lesion-level overlap F1 than SegAnyPET and nnUNet. translated_title: 一种用于PSMA PET/CT报告生成、视觉问答和病灶分割的统一视觉-语言模型
translated_abstract: 准确的PSMA PET/CT解读对前列腺癌的临床管理至关重要，然而现有的PET/CT AI模型通常只针对孤立的单一任务。我们提出了一种统一的PSMA PET/CT视觉-语言模型，可用于报告生成、视觉问答和病灶分割。该框架采用LLaVA风格的架构，包括PET/CT视觉编码器、MLP-Mixer投影模块、LoRA微调的大语言模型以及3D分割分支。训练遵循四阶段策略：视觉编码器预训练、投影层对齐、视觉-语言模型微调以及最终的多任务调优。语言任务使用了5,747例配有配对报告的PSMA PET/CT数据集，分割任务则使用了AutoPET的PSMA子集。该模型在标准报告生成指标上优于PET2REP和基于CT的基线模型，在各类VQA问题上均提升了性能，并且在Dice系数和病灶级重叠F1分数上超过了SegAnyPET和nnUNet。
tldr: 该研究提出了首个统一的PSMA PET/CT视觉-语言模型，能够同时完成报告生成、视觉问答和病灶分割三项任务，并在所有相关指标上超越了现有的专用模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified PSMA PET/CT vision-language model that simultaneously performs report generation, visual question answering, and lesion segmentation, outperforming existing task-specific models across all metrics.
